name: Big mushroom, lentil and peanut plate
description: A very large soy-free vegan breakfast plate for a high calorie target: fourteen cups of sliced mushrooms seared hard in dry pans, folded through warm cooked lentils and wilted spinach, then finished with dry roasted peanuts and torn basil for the fat and the last of the protein.
instructions: Set two wide non-stick pans over high heat, divide the mushrooms between them in a single layer and leave them undisturbed for 4 minutes so they brown rather than steam.
Stir once, add the salt and the black pepper, and cook for 3 minutes more until both pans are dry again.
Divide the lentils between the pans and warm them through for 2 minutes, pressing them lightly into the surface.
Fold in the spinach a handful at a time and cook for 1 minute, just until it collapses.
Pile everything onto one large plate, then scatter the peanuts and the torn basil over the top.
